set: D: tier 1 from above and You're Fired beside the approved images, whole and in crops

issues.where: the whole background behind the firehouse, top half and left side
issues.what: the cabinet walls behind are bright pale grey-white and evenly lit, so the close view reads as a daylit showroom; -a is a dark night scene where only the beacon, windows and door glow
issues.fix: take the background walls and rails down to near-black blue-grey with only thin chrome highlights, and drop overall exposure so the practical lights (beacon, windows, door) carry the frame

issues.what: the camera looks straight down, flat and orthographic, so every building shows only its roof and the page reads as a plan drawing; -a is a low oblique view in perspective where the brick and stone facades, windows and doors of each building are seen
issues.fix: tilt the tier camera to the -a angle (looking up the table from the apron, about 35-45 degrees off vertical) with mild perspective so facades and heights read

issues.where: the garage, right middle, overlapping the police station
issues.what: the garage is a large round drum with spokes like a bicycle wheel, seen from above, covering the police station's front; -a has a stacked clear-plastic spiral ramp on grey posts standing beside the police station
issues.fix: build the garage as a tiered spiral of clear ramps on vertical grey columns, set to the right of and below the police station so the station's front stays clear

issues.where: the floor around the ball and building base
issues.what: the page is matte with fine blueprint lines; -a's floor is dark glossy, wet-looking tiles with strong red and warm reflections spilling from the door and beacon
issues.fix: raise the page's clearcoat gloss so it mirrors the door glow, the windows and the beacon in soft streaked reflections; darken the page base

issues.where: the arrow inside the ball, centre
issues.what: the cursor is grey with water droplets on its face and the ball carries strong ring highlights and sparkles; in -a the cursor is clean matte white with a crisp black edge in a clear, quiet glass ball with one soft highlight
issues.fix: remove the droplet texture from the cursor, make it flat bright white with its dark edge, and cut the ball's specular rings to a single soft window highlight and a faint rim

issues.where: the arrow crop, ball on the highway
issues.what: the ball's interior reads dark and speckled with sparkles, so the cursor is grey and low-contrast; in -a the ball is clear glass and the white cursor stands out
issues.fix: make the glass clear with no dark interior fill or sparkle, and keep the cursor bright white

issues.where: all sign plaques (You're Fired, Background Check, Student Loans, Mom's Basement, Unemployment Office)
issues.what: the lettering is a bold black sans-serif on tan or brown plaques; -a uses a dark brown serif on cream enamel plaques with a thin gold bezel
issues.fix: set the sign lettering in a dark brown serif face of regular weight on cream plaques with a thin brass frame

issues.where: You're Fired sign on the roof
issues.what: the lettering is a black italic sans-serif on a tan plate; -a has a dark brown upright serif on cream with a gold edge
issues.fix: use the upright serif in dark brown on a cream plate with a brass edge

issues.where: left and right edges of the frame and the lift tube on the left
issues.what: the side rails are wide flat grey panels with rivets, and the lift tube is a wide dark column with lamps in it; -a has narrow brushed-chrome rails and a slim clear glass tube with chrome collars
issues.fix: narrow the side rails to thin polished chrome, and make the lift tube a slim, clear, reflective glass tube with chrome bands

issues.where: Student Loans bank, upper left under the firehouse
issues.what: the bank is a small grey box squeezed under the firehouse with a tiny sign; -a has a separate columned stone bank with its own frontage in the left middle, with three small gabled houses beside it
issues.fix: set the bank apart from the firehouse with its columned portico facing the camera, and put the row of three gabled houses to its right

issues.where: rows of small houses, lower left and lower right
issues.what: the little houses sit in flat boxed trays near the apron and read as coloured squares from above; in -a two rows of three red-roofed gabled houses with lit windows stand just above the slingshots
issues.fix: move the house rows up to the inlane shoulders above the slingshots and show their gabled roofs and lit windows

issues.where: the page, centre right running to lower left
issues.what: a large hard dark shadow from the highway and garage falls across the page, so the page looks unevenly lit; -a has soft, short shadows from a warm top light with pools of light round each lamp
issues.fix: soften and shorten the cast shadows of the highway and garage, and add warm light pools round the inserts, lamps and slingshots

issues.what: the buildings show only flat grey roofs with a strip of brick or blue at one edge; -a shows red-brick and blue-painted facades with rows of lit windows and the door
issues.fix: follows from the camera angle: show the facades, and give the police station blue-painted walls

issues.what: the slingshot is a flat yellow-black chevron triangle with no chrome ring and no lit glow; in -a it has a chrome wire guide and a rubber edge round it, posts at its corners, and a bright white glow underneath
issues.fix: add the chrome wire guide, the rubber and the corner posts, and light it from below with a warm white glow

issues.what: the apron is cool grey with large inset panels and extra text; -a's apron is a warm cream-white slab with only the Unemployment Office plaque in the middle
issues.fix: warm the apron to cream, remove the large grey insets, and leave the centre plaque as the only feature

issues.what: the flipper is plain orange with no dark rubber edge; -a has a black rubber band along its lower edge
issues.fix: add a thin black rubber stripe along the flipper's edge

issues.where: left of the firehouse, in front of the bank
issues.what: a row of pale green fence posts and a glowing grid panel on the roof have been added; neither appears in -a
issues.fix: remove the green posts and the lit roof grid, or tone them down to plain stone and roof grey

issues.what: the beacon's glow is pinkish and flat, spilling over the roof, where -a's is a deep red ribbed dome with a hot core and a chrome base
issues.fix: deepen the dome to saturated red, add a hot inner core and a polished chrome base ring, and cut the pink spill

issues.what: the brick is fine and uniform and the windows are bright and flat; -a's brick is weathered and uneven, with deep-set windows behind mullions
issues.fix: add mortar depth and colour variation to the brick, and recess the windows behind mullions
